rulingVerification.result: Ogapu triggers only actual castle fortification, not placing a castle card into a shield with Emeral/Shield Plus. Actual paid Emeral and ordinary face-up shield placement tested for both seats.

DuelParty nullifies extra turns but retains deployment. Reviewed only: this application supports two-player Original/Advance, not DuelParty. Two-player extra turn and existing Valhalla prohibition tested; multiplayer outcome is not claimed as reproduced.

validationNotes: Actual data nameKey9468→9471, three complete new original names: T2 Ogapu, Daisharin and Unknown. Official complete faces/basic information/mana1/limit4/current restrictions/images and exact same-name original-only product searches checked. No reprint aliases or duplicate rows added. Unknown official HTML has punctuation typo 時。 while printed image correctly has 時、; all intended clauses supported.

Ogapu uses native optional modal draw/bounce/neither after actual castle fortification. Both owner targets including itself, multiple castles/sources, actual paid castle and both existing free castle placement paths tested. QA35756 actual Emeral shield placement and ordinary face-up castle-as-card shield entry never trigger; enemy/ignored/sealed sources excluded. Fortification is a transient hook option, with no new persistent card fields or deck/save schema changes.

Daisharin grants native Charger at spell use time by cloning the resolving spell, leaving registry definitions unchanged. Paid multicolor, real Twinpact, free grave Execute, original Charger, actual Lucky Darts shield casting, source departure, enemy/ignored/sealed source and Genmu tested. QA43076 analogous actual Smash Burst explicitly accepted: spell resolves and is counted as a new spell while the one physical creature remains in battle. Initial test wrongly expected physical mana movement and was corrected from official ruling.

Rule101.5b/609.8a: granted Charger and Cyclone are competing own replacements; added native destination choice for this new grant. Actual printed Cyclone and actual Labereez grant both support hand/mana choices, JSON continuation, physical conservation and Reality Void prohibition/fallback. Existing spell-destination/history/Cyclone regressions pass.

Unknown uses native simultaneous hand selection before deployment and native summoned-entry-only gate. Paid10/14000/T, optional zero/partial/multiple creature deployment, native Bronze Arm CIP, actual evolution base, free Execute summon versus non-summon cheating, opponent additional turn and Valhalla prohibition tested. QA42911 reviewed as DuelParty-specific and not applicable to supported two-player formats; multiplayer reproduction is explicitly not claimed.

Final67 focused cases and affected short regression selections all pass, plus npm run check/audit/target/invariants. Failed attempts retained as fixture corrections (Twinpact targeting, wrong nonattacking Smash body, explicit cast acceptance and actual g16Smash native path) and rules-corrected expectation. No old full npm test or previously interrupted long group rerun. Existing definitions9468, IDs, catalogue/details/name aliases, image URLs and previous strict pins preserved.

One local verified batch only. No push, Pages or Netlify update. Keep historical registration/print/long-regression pending items and interrupted full-suite status unchanged. Continue ten-minute scheduled batches toward9500, remaining29; held Mestapo and Fushicho require broader precise native handling and are not counted.
